title: AI Agent Assigned Profile Map
summary: Workspace maps expose persistent Agent membership separately from execution ownership and report the latest observed execution for guarded removal.
required_policy_rules: server: include only currently active queued/running/stopping AI Agent assignments in assigned_agent_profiles
server: omit completed, stopped, failed, unassigned, and historical-only task threads from assigned_agent_profiles only
server: use the actual Riido component_id/task_id string as the key of both assigned_agent_profiles and task_agent_participants
server: assigned_agent_profiles maps each task to one legacy active AssignedAgentProfile value; task_agent_participants maps each task to a collection of visible persistent Agent participants
profile: avatar_url is copied from the assigned agent's profile_thumbnail_url when present
profile: tmp_color is the fixture-provided avatar fallback color copied into fixture-created agents; direct-created agents may omit it
client: use task_agent_participants for assigned participants and assigned_agent_profiles for legacy active avatar hints; use separate APIs for candidate selection and task-thread history
server: retain completed, stopped, and failed Agents in task_agent_participants until explicit participant removal; execution status does not delete membership
server: explicit participant removal omits that Agent from task_agent_participants without deleting or rewriting terminal execution history
server: task_agent_participants preserves workspace/private visibility and reports is_stop_required from the current active execution
server: latest_assignment_id identifies the latest retained execution of this task Agent regardless of execution status; omit it when no execution is retained
client: use latest_assignment_id only as the observed removal guard; membership and execution ownership are independent of this identifier

server: participant removal cancels the observed active executions before removing membership and returns 409 without removing membership if a new execution appears before the removal commit, including requests without assignment_id
invariants: Both maps use exact task/component ID keys.
Only assigned_agent_profiles is filtered to queued/running/stopping execution.
task_agent_participants retains visible completed/stopped/failed Agent membership until explicit removal.
Removing a participant preserves terminal results, failure diagnostics, and execution history.
Workspace/private visibility applies to persistent participants; is_stop_required reflects the active run.
latest_assignment_id observes the latest retained execution, including waiting/completed/failed executions, and is optional when execution history is absent.
A new execution between cancellation and participant removal yields 409 and preserves membership, including ID-less removal requests.

loop.observation: Historical waiting executions could select an outdated removal ID, and ID-less removal could erase membership while an interleaved new execution remained runnable.
loop.hypothesis: Separating the latest observed execution ID from membership/status and checking the observed execution generation at removal commit protects explicit removal without retaining execution ownership.
loop.execute: Verify optional latest assignment metadata, state-independent selection, guarded removal policy/scenarios, and DSL/IR/OpenAPI projections; verify runtime interleavings in control-plane.
loop.evaluate: CI rejects missing optional guard metadata, drifted removal policy/scenarios, and stale generated projections; runtime regression rejects removal after a new execution appears.
loop.retrospective: Membership remains durable while execution ownership is released; removal metadata only protects the observed execution generation.
